title: VII–IX. Matter: persons (angels and all humans) and all acts
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): 20:12). Their revelation stands as signified by ye opening belonging toward ye books (Rev. The acts stand as all thoughts, inclinations, gestures, words, plus deeds belonging toward all humans, together with their principles, circumstances, plus accidents. IX. || All humans living plus dead will be judged — ye good by a judgment belonging toward discernment plus absolution, ye evil belonging toward condemnation. The evil angels, already subject to punishments, will receive ye complement on ye last day. The persons stand as ye evil angels plus all humans both good plus evil. VIII. || The matter or object belonging toward ye last judgment stands as partly persons, partly their acts. VII.
pass_b_english: VII. The matter or object of the last judgment is partly persons, partly their acts.

VIII. The persons are the evil angels and all humans both good and evil. The evil angels, already subject to punishments, will receive the complement on the last day. All humans living and dead will be judged — the good by a judgment of discernment and absolution, the evil of condemnation.

IX. The acts are all thoughts, inclinations, gestures, words, and deeds of all humans, with their principles, circumstances, and accidents. Their revelation is signified by the opening of the books (Rev. 20:12).
source_text: VII. Materia sive objectum judicii extremi sunt partim personae, partim earum actus. VIII. Personae sunt angeli mali & homines omnes tam boni quam mali. Mali angeli jam poenis subjecti, in ultimo die complementum percipient. Homines judicabuntur omnes vivi & mortui — boni judicio discretionis & absolutionis, mali condemnationis. IX. Actus sunt omnes omnium hominum cogitationes, inclinationes, gestus, dicta, facta, cum principiis, circumstantiis & accidentibus. Horum revelatio significatur apertione librorum Apoc. 20.v.12.
